Order On Criminal Misc. 2nd Bail Application Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned A.G.A. for the State on Criminal Misc. 2nd Bail Application.
The first bail application of the appellant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 10.11.2021.

The instant bail application has been filed under Section 389 (1) Cr.P.C. against the judgement and order dated 17.10.2019 passed by the learned Additional District and Session Judge, Room No. 9,
Firozabad in Session Trial No. 420 of 2017, State Vs. Rajjo Devi and others whereby the appellant is convicted and sentenced under Section 498A I.P.C. for 2 year rigorous imprisonment and fine of Rs.
10,000/-, in default of payment of fine he had to undergo 3 months additional simple imprisonment, under Section 304-B I.P.C he was. sentenced for 10 years rigorous imprisonment and under section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act he was sentenced for 1 year rigorous imprisonment and fine of Rs. 5,000/-, in default of payment of fine he had to undergo 1 month additional simple Ram Kishor @ Bantu Alias Ram Kishan vs State Of U.P. on 11 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104734819/
1 imprisonment, all the punishments were to run concurrently and earlier detention in jail was to be adjusted in this sentence.

sentences.text: It is argued by the learned counsel for the appellant that on the ground of long incarceration, the appellant is entitled to be released on bail.
As per the report of Superintendent of Jail, Agra dated 08.08.2023, till that date the accused-appellant had undergone the custody of six years, four months and one day.
On this ground only, the prayer of bail is made.
Learned A.G.A. however, opposed the prayer for bail.
From the perusal of the postmortem report, it is found that death of the deceased was caused by hanging and no other injury except ligature mark was found on the person of the deceased.
The deceased was found hanging, in the presence of police and Circle Officer, dead body of the deceased was taken down.
The mother of the accused has already been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 10.11.2021 in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 7640 of 2019.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 7640 of 2019
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The appellant had completed his custody of six years four months and one day till 08.08.2023.
During trial the appellant was on bail.

As disposal of appeal would take time, there is no allegation of misusing the bail by the applicant during trial, so considering the submission of the parties, perusal of record, period of sentence and without expressing any opinion on the merits, I find that it is a fit case for grant of bail to the appellant/applicant during the pendency of the appeal.
During pendency of the appeal the sentence awarded to this appellant/applicant shall remain suspended.
The 2nd bail application is allowed.

Let the appellant/applicant Ram Kishor @ Bantu Alias Ram Kishan, convicted in the above mentioned case be released on bail during pendency of this appeal on furnishing personal bond and two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court with the condition that the appellant/applicant will co-operate with the hearing of the appeal.
